close_overlay_popup.task: Close any popup or overlay that appears on the page. Look for X buttons, close buttons, or dismiss buttons. If there is a 'Sign in' or 'Genius' popup, close it.

agentic_task.task: Search for hotels in {destination_city[0]}. First dismiss any popups by clicking X or close buttons. Then enter {destination_city[0]} in the destination search box and select it from suggestions. Set check-in to {check_in_date[0]} and check-out to {check_out_date[0]}. Set {number_of_rooms[0]} room. Click Search. Once results load, sort by lowest price first. Then click the first hotel in the sorted results.
